channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Gigi Hadid and Bradley Cooper married? Matching rings in Paris spark speculation
item.description: Gigi Hadid and Bradley Cooper have sparked marriage speculation after they were photographed wearing matching bands on their left ring fingers during a recent outing in Paris.

item.title: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle slam Elon Musk, Big Tech over AI-generated deepfakes targeting women and children
item.description: In a statement released through the Office of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex in August 2026, the couple praised new laws aimed at curbing AI-generated explicit imagery while condemning what they described as resistance from Big Tech to stronger safeguards.

item.title: Trump slams ‘fake’ pollsters, touts border security and Iran amid approval dip
item.description: “My REAL Polling Numbers, not those made up by the Fake News Media, are the best they have ever been,” Trump wrote.

item.title: Quote of the Day by Bradley Cooper: ‘You have to do everything you can. You have to work your hardest…’
item.description: Bradley Cooper’s quote on perseverance and positivity reflects the importance of sustained effort and hope, while echoing the determination that has shaped his journey as an actor and filmmaker.

item.title: Michigan confirms first Cyclospora deaths in US amid outbreak that has sickened over 20,000
item.description: Cyclospora is a microscopic, single-celled parasite that infects the small intestine and causes an illness known as cyclosporiasis.

item.title: Ariana Grande says she ‘cannot wait’ for Chicago concerts after announcing hiatus from public life
item.description: Ariana Grande has said she 'cannot wait' to perform for fans in Chicago, marking her first public engagement since announcing plans to step back from visibility after her tour.

item.title: Trump says US-Iran talks ‘going on right now’, calls it Tehran’s ‘last chance’ to reach deal
item.description: The comments come amid continued efforts to ease tensions following months of conflict between the United States and Iran, which has disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and heightened concerns over regional security.

item.title: Govt looks to bring back merchant fee on UPI transactions
item.description: The government plans amendments to extend tax exemptions for foreign contract manufacturing and potentially reintroduce merchant discount rates on UPI transactions.

item.title: WhatsApp puts multiple accounts, including in India, under 24-hour review; users report sudden restrictions
item.description: Several users reported that their accounts were unexpectedly flagged without prior notice, preventing them from using WhatsApp while the review process was underway, PTI stated.

item.title: Viral ‘Maharani’ clip floods Internet as Prashant Kishor bags Bankipur — ‘When you think you've figured out Bihar, it…’
item.description: Prashant Kishor's victory in the Bankipur bypoll has been termed the “beginning of the end” for the BJP, with social media widely citing a scene from Maharani to draw parallels with the unpredictability of Bihar's politics.

item.title: Quote of the day by filmmaker Clint Eastwood: '...You have to have criminal mentality to be film director'
item.description: Clint Eastwood emphasises that successful filmmakers borrow ideas from various sources, transforming them through their unique perspective.

item.title: Trump seen as growing political liability by Senate Republicans ahead of 2026 midterms: Report
item.description: Several Senate Republicans see Donald Trump as a growing political liability ahead of the 2026 midterms. GOP lawmakers cited his falling approval ratings, criticism of Senate leaders and controversial proposals as risks to the party's electoral prospects.

item.title: ‘Bangalore feels cheaper’: 21-year-old shares ₹43,000 monthly budget breakup while living alone in Gurgaon
item.description: A 21-year-old woman from Gurgaon has gone viral after revealing that her total expenditure for July was just over ₹43,000 while living by herself.

item.title: Trump blasts ‘duplicitous’ Iran, insists nuclear talks are underway despite Tehran’s denial
item.description: In a lengthy post on Truth Social, Trump claimed Iranian leaders were seeking negotiations behind closed doors while publicly denying any engagement with the United States.

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg must apologise over PM Modi video removal or lose safe harbour protection: Nishikant Dubey
item.description: Parliamentary panel chief Nishikant Dubey said Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg must personally apologise for the temporary removal of PM Narendra Modi's Facebook video or face withdrawal of the platform's safe harbour protection under the IT Act.

item.title: Kanwar Yatra 2026: Schools, colleges shut in Ghaziabad from August 4-12; Meerut, Baghpat join list
item.description: The Kanwar Yatra is an annual Hindu pilgrimage during the holy month of Shravan in which devotees of Lord Shiva carry holy Ganga water.

item.title: Trump tells oil companies to ‘get retail prices down now,’ criticizes Chevron CEO Mike Wirth
item.description: With crude prices now retreating following Trump's decision to hold off on military action against Iran, the President is urging oil companies to pass on the benefits of lower input costs to American motorists.

item.title: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat to interact with Gen Z, Gen Alpha students in Mumbai on August 6
item.description: More than 2,000 high school students aged between 15 and 19 years, representing over 100 cities across the country, are expected to attend the programme.

item.title: Iran's 'survival economy': Families sell empty perfume bottles, natural hair for income
item.description: The report said demand for rented laptops has also increased, with people hiring them for simple tasks such as typing documents, using Microsoft Office and attending online classes.

item.title: Why did Todd Blanche scrap Trump's $1.8 billion ‘anti-weaponization fund’ before attorney general confirmation vote?
item.description: The decision comes just days before the Senate Judiciary Committee is scheduled to vote on Blanche's nomination to become attorney general and follows weeks of negotiations with Republican Senators John Cornyn of Texas and Thom Tillis of North Carolina.

item.title: India hikes windfall tax on petrol, diesel and ATF exports from 3 August — Here's all you need to know
item.description: The Indian government has today increased windfall tax on petrol exports to ₹3.5 per litre from ₹2.5 per litre, effective from 3 August 2026, according to a Reuters report. Check rates here…&nbsp;

item.title: Bhaiyyaji Joshi steps down as Ram Temple Trust's patron, health cited as reason: Report
item.description: Senior RSS leader Bhaiyyaji Joshi has stepped down from his role as Palak (patron) of the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, with health cited as the official reason. His exit has triggered speculation over changes within the Ram Temple Trust.

item.title: Parliamentary panel takes tough stance on removal of Modi’s video from Facebook, seek accountability from Meta officials
item.description: Meta officials apologized, stating that the PM's video was briefly removed due to an error

item.title: New York weather alert: Flash flooding threat for NYC, New Jersey
item.description: A High Surf Advisory and High Rip Current Risk are in effect for several Atlantic-facing beaches, while a Flood Watch has been issued for parts of New York City and northern New Jersey due to the potential for heavy rainfall.

item.title: Parliament panel backs corporate law overhaul
item.description: The committee report on the Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, said the primary objective of the Bill is to simplify corporate legal procedures, reduce compliance burdens and strengthen corporate governance.

item.title: He quit an ₹11 LPA job in Bengaluru, now earns ₹28 lakh a year selling water in hometown
item.description: Ankit Pandey said the business generates nearly ₹9,000 in daily revenue, taking the monthly earnings to around ₹2.7 lakh.

item.title: India, Iran explore interim Chabahar Port management deal amid hopes of US sanctions relief
item.description: As New Delhi waits for US sanctions on Iran to be eased following a potential diplomatic agreement, it has stepped up efforts with Tehran to finalise a mechanism that safeguards India's strategic interests in Chabahar Port.&nbsp;

item.title: India, Uzbekistan target doubling bilateral trade in three years
item.description: Goyal said that though India-Uzbekistan bilateral trade has crossed around $1.5 billion, it still represents only a fraction of the potential between the two economies.

item.title: SC narrows 'criminal antecedents' clause from protest order; CJP says 'confusion' removed, seeks assurance from govt
item.description: Saurav Das said the party had ‘stood by every student and every protester’ throughout the protests and would continue to ‘closely monitor developments across states.’

item.title: Netaji's grandnephew Chandra Kumar Bose quits TMC, cites 'personal reasons'
item.description: In a resignation letter addressed to Mamata, Bose said he was stepping down from the primary membership of the Trinamool Congress with immediate effect.

item.title: Right to walk safely: SC orders Centre to ensure pedestrian walkways, reaffirms it as fundamental right
item.description: The Supreme Court affirmed pedestrian rights on demarcated sidewalks, directing the government to maintain these areas. Authorities must ensure safe walking spaces, separated from vehicle lanes, and provide legal remedies against violations.

item.title: Govt moots mandatory vehicle-to-vehicle communication in new vehicles from October 2028
item.description: In a move aimed at improving road safety and reducing accidents on highways, the ministry of road transport and highways has proposed making vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication systems mandatory in all new vehicles in a phased manner from October 2027 before full implementation a year later.

item.title: Jantar Mantar no longer suitable venue for protests? Supreme Court seeks Centre, Delhi govt's stand
item.description: The petition has sought directions to designate an alternative venue for such protests.

item.title: US military sends unusual email seeking 'creative and unconventional' ideas to ‘punish’ Iran: Report
item.description: The email was sent before Trump threatened fresh strikes on Iran but later decided against them over the weekend after regional leaders, including Saudi Arabia's Crown Prince, urged him to de-escalate the conflict.

item.title: IMD warns of flash flood risk in northeast as monsoon intensifies across India
item.description: Heavy to extremely heavy rainfall is forecast over the Northeast, eastern and northwestern India over the next week, with low-lying areas in parts of Arunachal Pradesh, Assam and Meghalaya facing flash flood risk.
